# Fullscape v1.4.2

- Improves fullscreen layouts across display sizes. Portrait mode keeps lyrics below the player, and narrower landscape layouts use more of the available height while scaling the cover and playback controls together.
- Keeps the **Up Next** artwork at 2 × 2 tiles across queue layouts. The staggered artwork wall keeps upcoming tracks in playback order, and the narrow layout aligns the queue heading with the first small cover.
- Keeps long lyric lines, translations, and pronunciation guides readable in tight layouts. Interlude dots follow the upcoming vocal line, including its alignment.
- Reduces work during lyric scrolling and playback updates.
- Simplifies playback and appearance settings. Fullscape detects portrait layouts automatically, keeps the progress bar and playback controls visible, and removes the legacy playback color and contrast overrides.

## Install or update

Download `fullscape.js`, copy it to your Spicetify Extensions directory, then run the following commands.

```sh
spicetify config extensions fullscape.js
spicetify apply
```

Existing Fullscape installations can also select this release through the built-in update settings. The release includes `fullscape.js.sha256` for checksum verification.
